title: Require Owner
statement: Implement `solve(owner)`. Strip `owner`. If it is empty, return the string `error`. Otherwise return the stripped owner. This is the check an initializer should make before it stores the name.
constraints: Blank and whitespace-only names are error
A real name is returned stripped

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An initializer that stores a blank owner creates an object the rest of the system cannot address.

editorial: An initializer that stores a blank owner creates an object the rest of the system cannot address. Failing in __init__ beats a later AttributeError or a silent empty invoice. The stripped value is what you would assign to self.owner.
